# Allo Cars

Free car tools and open data for drivers in Germany, by Spiking Labs (part of allo.land). Tool inputs live in the URL, so a filled-in link reproduces a result. Machine-readable tool list: https://cars.allo.land/tools.json

## MCP server
https://cars.allo.land/mcp is a read-only MCP server (streamable HTTP, no login) for AI assistants. Add it as a custom connector in Claude (Settings > Connectors) or any MCP client. Tools: lookup_official_consumption, get_recalls, check_used_car, get_recall_statistics, get_fuel_prices, get_charging_prices, get_cheapest_charging_time, get_registrations, find_chargers. Every result links to the matching page.

## Tools
- [My cars](https://cars.allo.land/cars/): one page per car model joining official consumption, cost per 100 km at today's prices, recalls matching the first registration year and German registrations. Link parameters: ?car=<vehicle catalog id, e.g. vw-golf-diesel>&year=<first registration year>. People keep several cars on their own device.
- [EV charging cost vs petrol and diesel](https://cars.allo.land/ev-cost/): cost per 100 km at any price per kWh for your EV, and the break-even electricity price against popular German petrol and diesel cars. Any electric car sold in Germany can be picked by name (car=Kia EV9); levels then come from its official figure. Parameters: https://cars.allo.land/ev-cost/spec.json
- [Charging price archive](https://cars.allo.land/charging-prices/): ad-hoc charging prices in Germany over time.
- [Fuel prices](https://cars.allo.land/fuel-prices/): weekly petrol, diesel and LPG prices in Germany since 2005. Link parameters: ?fuel=euro_super_95|diesel|lpg, ?range=1y|5y|all
- [Cheapest time to charge](https://cars.allo.land/charge-times/): cheapest 1 to 8 hour window to charge at home today and tomorrow, from German day-ahead exchange prices. Timing only pays on a dynamic tariff. Link parameters: day, h, kwh, tariff=dynamic|fixed, grid, markup, fixed.
- [New car registrations by model](https://cars.allo.land/registrations/): monthly new registrations in Germany for every model since 2018, the top 20 and the electric share. Open a model with ?model=<slug>, e.g. ?model=volvo-ex30.
- [Car recalls and used-car check](https://cars.allo.land/recalls/): official recalls for a car in Europe (EU Safety Gate, including every KBA recall) and the US (NHTSA), narrowed to the build window of a used car, with what to ask the seller, and recall statistics by year, component and brand (per 100,000 new cars registered in Germany). Link parameters: ?brand=<slug>&model=<name>&year=<first registration year>.
- [Charger map](https://cars.allo.land/chargers/): every public charger in Germany. Link parameters: lat, lon, z (zoom; single chargers from 11), kw (0, 11, 50, 150), plug (type2,ccs,chademo), only (247,card,free,public). Example: https://cars.allo.land/chargers/?lat=50.9375&lon=6.9603&z=13&kw=150&plug=ccs
- [Charging stations in numbers](https://cars.allo.land/chargers/stats/): rankings of towns, districts and states by charge points per 100,000 people, fast points, electric cars per charge point and kW per electric car; power classes, plugs, growth by year, operators. Link parameters: rank (towns, districts, states), by (per100k, points, fast, bev, kw), q (filter), areas (comma separated regional keys, e.g. 053150000000,053140000000 for Köln and Bonn together). Example: https://cars.allo.land/chargers/stats/?rank=districts&by=bev

## Data
- [Ad-hoc EV charging prices, latest](https://cars.allo.land/data/charging-prices/latest.json): median, p10, p90 of the base energy price (EUR/kWh incl. VAT) over all published ad-hoc tariffs, overall and per data source.
- [Daily price history](https://cars.allo.land/data/charging-prices/daily.csv): one row per day and source (date, source, tariffs, median, p10, p90, min, max). Collection started 2026-11-06.
- [Current tariffs](https://cars.allo.land/data/charging-prices/tariffs.csv): every ad-hoc tariff with energy, time, parking and session prices.
- [Charging prices by operator](https://cars.allo.land/data/charging-prices/operators.csv): median EUR/kWh per operator, overall and for AC, DC (below 150 kW) and high-power (150 kW+) charge points; latest.json has the same in by_operator and by_power.
- [Daily prices by charger type](https://cars.allo.land/data/charging-prices/daily_power.csv): date, power (ac, dc, hpc), charge_points, median, p10, p90, min, max.
- [Daily prices by operator](https://cars.allo.land/data/charging-prices/daily_operators.csv)
- [Sources and licences](https://cars.allo.land/data/charging-prices/sources.json)
- [Weekly fuel prices](https://cars.allo.land/data/fuel-prices/weekly.csv): date, euro_super_95, diesel, lpg in EUR per litre incl. taxes, weekly since 2005 (EU Weekly Oil Bulletin, CC BY 4.0).
- [Fuel prices, latest week](https://cars.allo.land/data/fuel-prices/latest.json): this week per fuel, change on last week, 4- and 52-week averages. Other countries: /data/fuel-prices/<region>/ (list in /data/fuel-prices/index.json).
- [Public chargers, counts](https://cars.allo.land/data/chargers/de/latest.json): locations, charge points, fast (50 kW+) and high-power (150 kW+) counts overall, per federal state and per operator, plus the plug and flag bit meanings and the list of cells.
- [Public chargers, all locations](https://cars.allo.land/data/chargers/de/stations.csv): position, max kW, charge points, DC points, plugs, operator, address, 24/7, card payment, free, customers only, year opened.
- [Public chargers, statistics](https://cars.allo.land/data/chargers/de/stats.json): totals, per state, per district (with population and battery electric cars) and per town of 50,000+ people; points per 100,000 people, electric cars per point, kW per electric car; points by power class, plug and year; top operators. Same per district as CSV: https://cars.allo.land/data/chargers/de/districts.csv. Power classes, plugs, years and top operators for every state, district and town: https://cars.allo.land/data/chargers/de/areas.json
- Public chargers in one area: https://cars.allo.land/data/chargers/de/cells/<a>_<b>.json with a = floor(lat × 2), b = floor(lon × 2), e.g. cells/101_13.json for Cologne. Rows follow "fields"; operator is an index into "operators".
- [Electricity prices today and tomorrow](https://cars.allo.land/data/electricity-prices/de/latest.json): day-ahead exchange prices for Germany in 15-minute steps, cheapest windows, estimated dynamic tariff price.
- [Daily electricity prices since 2018](https://cars.allo.land/data/electricity-prices/de/daily.csv) and [hourly](https://cars.allo.land/data/electricity-prices/de/hourly.csv), EUR/MWh.
- [Car recalls in Europe, latest](https://cars.allo.land/data/recalls/eu/latest.json): counts and newest EU Safety Gate motor vehicle alerts.
- [Recalls per model](https://cars.allo.land/data/recalls/eu/models.json): followed models with files models/<slug>.json (EU) and https://cars.allo.land/data/recalls/us/models/<slug>.json (NHTSA).
- [Recalls per brand](https://cars.allo.land/data/recalls/eu/brands.json), files brand/<slug>.json.
- [Recall statistics](https://cars.allo.land/data/recalls/eu/stats.json): alerts per year and vehicle type, per component (sorted from the hazard text), per brand with alerts per 100,000 new cars registered in Germany.
- [All car recalls since 2019 (CSV)](https://cars.allo.land/data/recalls/eu/recalls.csv)
- [New registrations, latest month](https://cars.allo.land/data/registrations/de/latest.json): all new cars by drive type, top 20 models, top 10 electric models, change on a year before.
- [Registrations, model list](https://cars.allo.land/data/registrations/de/models.json): every model with slug, file, newest count, rank and last 12 months. One model's monthly series: https://cars.allo.land/data/registrations/de/models/<slug>.json
- [Registrations, every model every month](https://cars.allo.land/data/registrations/de/monthly.csv) and [market by drive type](https://cars.allo.land/data/registrations/de/market.csv). Source © Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt, Flensburg (FZ10), dl-de/by-2-0.
- [Vehicle catalog, Germany](https://cars.allo.land/data/vehicle-catalog/de/models.json) (also [CSV](https://cars.allo.land/data/vehicle-catalog/de/models.csv), [electric only](https://cars.allo.land/data/vehicle-catalog/de/electric.json), [EU-27](https://cars.allo.land/data/vehicle-catalog/eu/models.json)): official WLTP consumption per car model and fuel type (kwh_per_100km at the plug, l_per_100km, co2_g_km, power_kw, mass_kg), registration-weighted over the versions sold, with new registrations in the year. Models no longer sold new stay in, back to 2021 (year = year of the figures, the newest year the model still sold well; years = first and last year sold new). From the EEA CO2 monitoring of new cars (CC BY 4.0), refreshed monthly. Official figures, lower than real-world use.

Charging prices come from the Open ChargePoint Database (MobiData BW), which merges AFIR feeds published on Mobilithek; licences per source are in sources.json. Chargers come from the Bundesnetzagentur Ladesäulenregister (CC BY 4.0, Bundesnetzagentur.de).

## Regions
Data is arranged by region: https://cars.allo.land/data/<dataset>/<region>/<file>, with lowercase ISO codes (de for Germany). The list of regions, and which datasets each has, is at https://cars.allo.land/regions.json. Germany is the only region so far; the short URLs above without a region are Germany. Add ?country=<code> to any page link to pick the country.

## Pages
Every page is also in German under /de/ (for example https://cars.allo.land/de/ev-cost/) and in Simplified Chinese under /zh/ (for example https://cars.allo.land/zh/ev-cost/), with the same link parameters.

- [My cars](https://cars.allo.land/cars/)
- [Charging price history](https://cars.allo.land/charging-prices/)
- [Fuel prices](https://cars.allo.land/fuel-prices/)
- [Cheapest time to charge](https://cars.allo.land/charge-times/)
- [Car recalls](https://cars.allo.land/recalls/)
- [New registrations by model](https://cars.allo.land/registrations/)
- [Charger map](https://cars.allo.land/chargers/)
- [Charging stations in numbers](https://cars.allo.land/chargers/stats/)
- [Data and sources](https://cars.allo.land/open-data/)
- [Imprint and privacy](https://cars.allo.land/legal/)
